description: Plan v7 section 8.3 zero-boundary clause: maximumExpressionNestingDepth is non-negative, so zero builds, and it is the one expression setting that forbids grouping outright. Every expression here is the parenthesis-free form of the corresponding expression in runtime-limits-expression-nesting-one, so group depth never leaves zero and the catalog compiles; an implementation that counted an implicit top-level group would reject it. Holding the operands identical also lets the case pairs show that the grouped and ungrouped forms evaluate alike.
